name: SoftEther VPN Self-Hosted
free_limit: Free Apache-2.0 open-source VPN Server, Client and Bridge for commercial or personal use; supports SSL-VPN, OpenVPN, L2TP/IPsec and site-to-site VPN without software license fees.
watch_out: Requires your own server, public network access, secure configuration and patching. Bandwidth, VPS and any external services are not included; no managed VPN service or SLA is provided.
